{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2024}}
'''EL++''' is a lightweight [[description logic]] that was designed to
<blockquote>
*capture the [[expressive power (computer science)|expressive power]] that is used by large-scale [[ontologies]] from practical applications
*have polytime reasoning problems, in particular classification and instance checking
<sub>(www.w3.org 2010)</sub>
</blockquote>

'''EL++''' has been incorporated into [[OWL 2]] as a [http://www.w3.org/TR/2009/REC-owl2-profiles-20091027/#OWL_2_EL OWL 2 EL Profile].

==References==
{{reflist}}
* Franz Baader, Sebastian Brandt, Carsten Lutz: Pushing the EL Envelope.  IJCAI 2005: 364–369
